{{Top|leg}}
A '''flat-image photoimager''' was one of the many [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attachments that [[Q9-X2]] modified themselves with. The attachment was capable of reproducing a non-[[holograph]]ic image of anything within a fifty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] range. Creating the image took around ninety [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
